selected_source_files.classification: Prompt startup splits into prepare and start so extension-triggered custom messages share before_agent_start, and an abort requested during that startup calls agent.abort() when agent_start fires. The selected invocation passes --no-extensions, so those handlers are not loaded. PromptDisposition stays handled, queued, or started; steering and follow-up stay handled or queued; agent_settled.aborted stays a required boolean. dist/modes/rpc is byte-identical, so forwarded RPC event and response shapes do not change.
